response.sql:
WITH counted AS (
  SELECT 
    r.ordervault,
    o.orderflow,
    COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM riskandmargin r
  INNER JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY r.ordervault, o.orderflow
),
status_totals AS (
  SELECT
    orderflow,
    SUM(cnt) as status_total_count
  FROM counted
  GROUP BY orderflow
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT
    c.ordervault,
    c.orderflow,
    c.cnt,
    c.cnt::float / st.status_total_count as share
  FROM counted c
  JOIN status_totals st ON c.orderflow = st.orderflow
),
status_averages AS (
  SELECT
    orderflow,
    AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM with_shares
  GROUP BY orderflow
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT
    ws.ordervault,
    ws.orderflow,
    ws.cnt,
    ws.share,
    ws.share - sa.avg_share as difference
  FROM with_shares ws
  JOIN status_averages sa ON ws.orderflow = sa.orderflow
  WHERE ws.share > sa.avg_share
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    ordervault,
    orderflow,
    cnt,
    share,
    difference,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY difference DESC) as rn
  FROM filtered
),
result_set AS (
  SELECT
    ordervault,
    orderflow,
    cnt,
    share,
    difference
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn <= 10
)
SELECT
  ordervault,
  orderflow,
  cnt,
  share,
  difference
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 10 OR difference = (SELECT MIN(difference) FROM result_set)
ORDER BY difference DESC

assumptions.assumption: Share is calculated as (count for this ordervault/orderflow combination) / (total count across all combinations for that orderflow), yielding a decimal proportion.
Average share per status is the arithmetic mean of share values across all combinations with that status.
"Dropping records with no matching order" means INNER JOIN: exclude any riskandmargin records lacking a corresponding orders row.
"Without rounding" preserves full floating-point precision in the output (share and difference columns).
